page.notes: Marginal note "Cap.3." in the left margin, beside the line "cet Philosophus" (at the start of the paragraph's third-to-last line region). Its reading is clear. Several words are marked by print irregularities: "stirpis" appears printed as "stirpis"-like form and is read as stirpis; "nô" is printed with a tilde over the o; "quic quam" appears as printed; "poris" is the last word of the page, which continues on the next page. The text reads "conceptus non fit actu animatus" in the scan; the transcription above reads "sit actu" as printed. The line "propterea quod forma essentialis est cor-" is hyphenated at the line end and continues as "poris". Some letters are faint due to ink and paper wear, notably in "uegetalem" and "conceptibus"; they were read as shown but are not fully certain.
